newsitem.title: USA: FCNB Corp to merge two subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: FCNB Corp to merge two subsidiaries.

text.p: FCNB Corp said Wednesday it planned to merge two subsidiaries in Maryland by March 1997 in an effort to strengthen its banking franchise in that state.
FCNB said it would merge Elkridge Bank with FCNB Bank to create a bank with assets totalling $729 million.
It said it expected the merger to lead to pretax annual savings totalling some $900,000.
FCNB said the move would also improve chances of improving efficiency, growth and revenue.
Elkridge Bank is based in Elkridge, Maryland with five branches in Howard, Prince George's and Anne Arundel counties, while FCNB has 16 branches in Frederick, Carroll and Montgomery counties.
